pillars.title: Full-Stack Software Developer
pillars.content: Specializing in end-to-end web engineering, integrating responsive React frontends with high-throughput FastAPI and Django backends. Driven by clean code architecture, modular design, and reliable CRUD workflows.

pillars.title: From Core Engineering to Scalable Web Systems
pillars.content: With an engineering foundation in Electronics & Communications, I transitioned into software development, mastering data structures, algorithms, relational database modeling, and scalable modern web stacks.

pillars.title: Production Deployment & API Integration
pillars.content: Engineered enterprise management dashboards, deployed cloud-hosted web applications, and integrated complex third-party APIs to deliver seamless user experiences and operational automation.

pillars.title: Performance, Reliability & Clean Schemas
pillars.content: I advocate for structured object-oriented programming, normalized relational schemas with PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy, rigorous API contract testing in Postman, and responsive, accessible interfaces.
